rows.comment: He examines precisely these and other human voids in his characters.
rows.verdict_le10: He examines precisely these and other human voids in his characters.
rows.dek_lead: Death, physical deformity, loss, the emotionally bereft – all come to the well in Lee’s devastating, acutely intelligent film. He examines precisely these and other human voids in his characters.
